mapper.insert: insert into user_refresh_token(session_id, token_hash, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) values(#{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, session_id, token_hash, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from user_refresh_token where token_hash = #{tokenHash} limit 1
